extracted_claim: glGenBuffers generates n buffer object names. Names are not guaranteed contiguous. No buffer objects are associated until first bound with glBindBuffer. Names are not reused until deleted with glDeleteBuffers.
implementation_relevance: HSE must generate buffers with glGenBuffers, bind them before use, and delete with glDeleteBuffers when done. The VBO lifecycle in HSE follows this pattern.

hse_symbol_grounding.notes: HSE Primitive class has m_vao, m_vbo, m_ebo. These are OpenGL buffer objects created via glGenBuffers.

extracted_claim: After binding a buffer with glBindBuffer, data is uploaded with glBufferData. The usage hint (GL_STATIC_DRAW, GL_DYNAMIC_DRAW, GL_STREAM_DRAW) tells the driver how the buffer will be used. glBufferSubData can update a sub-region. glGetBufferParameteriv with GL_BUFFER_SIZE verifies upload success.
implementation_relevance: HSE uses GL_STATIC_DRAW for vertex data that doesn't change. The verification pattern (check GL_BUFFER_SIZE after upload) is a robust practice HSE should adopt.

hse_symbol_grounding.notes: HSE uploads vertex/index data via glBufferData. No verification of upload success is currently implemented.

extracted_claim: Standard buffer lifecycle: (1) glGenBuffers to create, (2) glBindBuffer to bind to target, (3) glBufferData to allocate and upload, (4) verify with glGetBufferParameteriv, (5) use for rendering, (6) glDeleteBuffers when done. For vertex buffers: bind to GL_ARRAY_BUFFER. For index buffers: bind to GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER.
implementation_relevance: HSE Primitive class follows this lifecycle for m_vao (vertex array), m_vbo (vertex buffer), and m_ebo (element buffer). The cleanup (glDeleteBuffers) should be called in the destructor.

hse_symbol_grounding.notes: HSE Primitive constructor creates VAO/VBO/EBO. Destructor should clean them up.
